name: Hubei Shennongjia
description: Hubei Shennongjia is a mountain region in central China's Hubei Province, split into two protected areas: Shennongding/Badong in the west and Laojunshan in the east. It holds the largest primary forests left in central China, home to golden snub-nosed monkeys, clouded leopards, Asian black bears and giant salamanders. Plant hunters from around the world came here in the 19th and 20th centuries.
